subject: planner: fix the duplicate offset when pushing topn down across outer join (#57471)
summary: Planner-only change: `LogicalJoin.PushDownTopN` now tracks when a TopN can be fully pushed to the outer side of an outer join (inner join keys unique) and avoids double-applying OFFSET by eliminating the parent TopN, preserving ORDER BY via a `LogicalSort` when needed. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in this area relative to upstream/master (the pure-LIMIT variant was handled later in fd7f07f5f2 / #59927).
